dedupe_keys.name: high speed railway network dataset from train operation records and weather data china

description: This dataset describes the Chinese high-speed railway network through the operation records of 3,399 high-speed trains at 727 stations from 8 October 2019 to 27 January 2020. The authors scraped 2,751,713 running records, with scheduled and actual arrival and departure times, from the China Railway ticket system (12306.cn) and enriched them with train direction, station type, weather, temperature, wind and major holidays. Four CSV files hold the train operation data, the number of delayed trains per hour at each station and direction, data on ten main junctions and the mileage between adjacent stations. It was produced at Beijing Jiaotong University with the National Research Center of Railway Safety Assessment and described in Scientific Data in 2022. Coverage is the national high-speed network of China. Access: free download from figshare under CC0 (version 4, April 2022). Caveats: the period is 16 weeks, and the data were scraped from a ticketing website, not released by the operator. It supports delay propagation and reliability analysis, network resilience and cascading failure studies of high-speed rail, and weather impact modelling, and complements the Norwegian train movements and the Italian railway network dataset catalogued here.
